note: Rollback targets must be healthy backend releases in releases.jsonl whose database schema head is at least min_rollback_schema_version. Raise it to the new migration number when a forward-only migration breaks older readers (migration 22 deleted data). Releases recorded before the ledger have no known schema head and are never rollback targets. min_rollback_revision is the commit the release rehearsal (scripts/release_rehearsal.py) builds as the oldest supported rollback image; raise it together with min_rollback_schema_version.
